current_official_name: Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students (PM-USP CSSS)
department: Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education
scheme_description: Central Sector scholarship scheme under the Pradhan Mantri Uchchatar Shiksha Protsahan (PM-USP) umbrella providing financial support to meritorious students from economically weaker families to meet day-to-day expenses while pursuing regular full-time higher education in recognized colleges and universities.
description: Financial assistance to meritorious students from low-income families pursuing regular graduate and post-graduate college/university courses.
target_beneficiaries: Meritorious Class 12 pass-out students pursuing regular undergraduate or postgraduate degree courses in recognized institutions
application_status_evidence: National Scholarship Portal (NSP) official schedule for AY 2026-27: Fresh & Renewal student registration closed on 31 October 2026; Institute (Level 1) verification active until 15 November 2026; DNO/SNO (Level 2) verification active until 30 November 2026.

current_guideline_version.version_title: PM-USP Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students Guidelines
current_guideline_version.issuing_authority: Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education

historical_guideline_info.key_differences: Graduation scholarship rate was Rs. 10,000 per annum for the first three years; enhanced to Rs. 12,000 per annum under the revised PM-USP umbrella from 1 April 2022.

eligibility.gender_requirement: ALL (50% of slots earmarked for female students)
eligibility.income_definition: Gross annual family income from all sources during the financial year
eligibility.education_requirement: Passed Class 12 (or equivalent) in current examination year
eligibility.minimum_marks_requirement: > 80th percentile of successful candidates in the respective stream (Science, Commerce, Humanities) from the respective State Examination Board / CBSE / CISCE
eligibility.course_requirement: Regular full-time undergraduate or postgraduate degree courses. Distance education, diploma courses, and correspondence courses are strictly ineligible.
eligibility.institution_requirement: Colleges and universities recognized by UGC, AICTE, MCI/NMC, or respective statutory regulatory bodies
eligibility.disability_requirement: 5% horizontal reservation earmarked for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (>= 40% disability)
other_eligibility_conditions: Must not have taken a gap year after Class 12 examination
Must have an active bank account seeded with Aadhaar for DBT transfer
Must not be in receipt of any other Central or State Government scholarship or fee reimbursement
exclusions: Students pursuing diploma courses
Students studying through correspondence, distance, or open university modes
Students taking a gap year after passing Class 12
Students receiving any other Government scholarship or fee reimbursement
eligibility.renewal_conditions: Must obtain minimum 50% marks in annual or semester exams, maintain at least 75% attendance, and maintain good conduct without disciplinary action.

structured_rules.explanation: Gross annual family income from all sources must not exceed Rs. 4,50,000 per annum.
Student must score above the 80th percentile in the relevant stream of the respective Class 12 Board examination.
Must be pursuing regular full-time degree courses; distance or correspondence courses are excluded.
Beneficiary must not receive any other scholarship or tuition reimbursement from Central or State Government.
Fresh applicant must have passed Class 12 in the current academic year without a gap year.
For renewal in subsequent years, student must score at least 50% marks in previous year examinations.
Student must maintain a minimum of 75% attendance during the academic year for renewal.

benefits.disbursement_frequency: Annual (DBT directly into student Aadhaar-seeded bank account)
benefits.duration: Up to 5 years (3 years UG + 2 years PG, or 5 years integrated/professional courses)
benefits.maximum_benefit: Rs. 12,000 per annum for first 3 years of UG; Rs. 20,000 per annum for 4th and 5th year / PG courses

required_documents.applicable_condition: All applicants (must be individual savings account)
For PwD quota candidates (>= 40% benchmark disability)

application_steps: Step 1: Complete Aadhaar-based One-Time Registration (OTR) on the National Scholarship Portal (NSP).
Step 2: Log in using OTR credentials and select Department of Higher Education -> Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students.
Step 3: Enter Class 12 Board examination details (roll number, board name, year of passing) and current degree admission details.
Step 4: Upload required documents including Income Certificate, Class 12 Marksheet, and College Bonafide Certificate.
Step 5: Submit application for online Level 1 verification by the Institute Nodal Officer (INO).
Step 6: Followed by State Nodal Officer verification and DBT disbursement into Aadhaar-seeded bank account.
renewal_deadline: Concurrent with fresh application timelines on NSP (student submission closed 2026-10-31)
selection_process: Inter-se merit based on state board percentile quota (82,000 total scholarships allocated across boards based on 18-25 population in 3:1:3 ratio for Science:Commerce:Humanities, with 50% reservation for female students and 5% for PwD).
grievance_contact: NSP Helpdesk: helpdesk@nsp.gov.in / National Scholarship Portal Grievance Portal
application_tracking_information: Supported online via NSP OTR portal login and Public Financial Management System (PFMS) DBT tracking

current_guideline_version.issuing_authority: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)

historical_guideline_info.key_differences: Originally provided 4,000 scholarships annually. Expanded in AY 2020-21 to 10,000 scholarships (5,000 Degree + 5,000 Diploma) with lateral entry eligibility and regional open accommodation for 13 UTs and North Eastern States.

eligibility.income_definition: Total annual family income from all sources must not exceed Rs. 8 Lakh during the current financial year
eligibility.education_requirement: Admitted to 1st year of technical Degree/Diploma course OR 2nd year through lateral entry in an AICTE-approved institution through Centralized Admission Process of State/Central Government
eligibility.minimum_marks_requirement: Merit determined based on percentage of marks obtained in the qualifying examination (10+2 for Degree; 10th for Diploma)
eligibility.course_requirement: Technical Degree (e.g. B.Tech, B.E., B.Pharm, B.Arch) or Technical Diploma courses
eligibility.family_status_requirement: Maximum two girl children per family are eligible
other_eligibility_conditions: Must have secured admission through Centralized Admission Process (CAP) of State/Central Government in AICTE-approved institution
Must possess an active individual savings bank account seeded with Aadhaar
exclusions: More than two girl children from the same family
Students pursuing technical courses in non-AICTE approved institutions
Students admitted through Management Quota or direct institutional quota without centralized counseling
Students availing any other Central/State/AICTE scholarship benefits
eligibility.renewal_conditions: Renewal is contingent on passing the year/semester examinations and submitting renewal application along with passing marksheets and bonafide certificate via NSP.

structured_rules.explanation: Candidate must be female.
Total annual family income from all sources must not exceed Rs. 8,00,000 during the current financial year.
Maximum of two girl children per family can avail this scholarship.
The institution where the candidate is admitted must be AICTE-approved.
Admission must be secured through the Centralized Admission Process (CAP) of State/Central Government; management quota is excluded.
Candidate must be admitted to 1st year of Degree/Diploma or 2nd year through lateral entry.
Candidate must not be recipient of any other Government or AICTE scholarship.

benefits.duration: Maximum 4 years for Degree (3 years for lateral entry); maximum 3 years for Diploma (2 years for lateral entry)
benefits.maximum_benefit: Rs. 50,000 per annum lump-sum covering college tuition fees, computer/equipment, books, stationery, and software

required_documents.applicable_condition: Class 12 for Degree; Class 10 for Diploma
All applicants (stating income <= Rs. 8 Lakh for current financial year)

required_documents.document_name: Centralized Admission Allotment Letter / CAP Proof
required_documents.applicable_condition: Fresh applicants (proving admission via Central/State Government counseling)
required_documents.issuing_authority: Centralized Admission Authority / State CET Cell

required_documents.document_name: Bonafide Certificate from Head of Institution

required_documents.applicable_condition: Mandatory official declaration signed by parent certifying max two girl children limit

application_steps: Step 1: Register on the National Scholarship Portal (NSP) and generate One-Time Registration (OTR).
Step 2: Log in and select AICTE Pragati Scholarship Scheme (Degree or Diploma as applicable).
Step 3: Complete applicant profile, bank details, and institutional admission details.
Step 4: Upload required documents including family income certificate for current financial year, Annexure-III parent declaration, bonafide certificate, CAP allotment proof, and marksheet.
Step 5: Submit application for Level 1 institutional verification.
Step 6: Followed by AICTE / State Nodal Officer verification and DBT disbursement.
renewal_deadline: Concurrent with fresh application timelines on NSP (student submission open through 2026-11-30)
selection_process: Inter-se merit based on qualifying exam scores across 10,000 annual slots (5,000 Degree + 5,000 Diploma distributed across 23 States/UTs) with reservation for SC (15%), ST (7.5%), and OBC (27%). In addition, all eligible girl students from 13 specific UTs and North Eastern States submitting applications online are accommodated.

application_tracking_information: Supported on NSP portal via OTR login

scheme_description: Targeted scholarship implemented by AICTE providing Rs. 50,000 per annum to differently-abled students with benchmark disability not less than 40% admitted to first-year technical Degree/Diploma courses (or second-year lateral entry) in AICTE-approved institutions.
description: Financial assistance of Rs. 50,000 per annum for differently-abled students (>= 40% disability) pursuing technical degree or diploma courses in AICTE-approved institutions.

current_guideline_version.issuing_authority: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)

historical_guideline_info.key_differences: Originally enforced a fixed quota cap of 1,000 scholarships per annum (500 Degree + 500 Diploma). In AY 2020-21, Clause 3.0 was revised to open intake for all eligible specially-abled students who meet admission and verification criteria.

eligibility.income_definition: Total annual family income from all sources during the current financial year
eligibility.education_requirement: Admitted to 1st year of technical Degree/Diploma course OR 2nd year through lateral entry in an AICTE-approved institution through Centralized Admission Process
eligibility.minimum_marks_requirement: Passing marks in qualifying examination required for admission
eligibility.course_requirement: Technical Degree or Diploma program in AICTE-approved institution
eligibility.disability_requirement: Disability level must not be less than 40% certified by a Competent Medical Authority (UDID Card preferred and integrated with NSP online verification, or Civil Surgeon / Medical Board certificate)
other_eligibility_conditions: Must have an active individual savings bank account seeded with Aadhaar
Must not receive any other concurrent scholarship or stipend from Central or State Government
Must provide consent for UDID online authentication on NSP where applicable
exclusions: Disability level below 40%
Courses in non-AICTE approved institutions
Annual family income exceeding Rs. 8 Lakh
Students availing concurrent Central or State Government scholarships
eligibility.renewal_conditions: Promotion to the next academic year without backlogs/discontinuation, and submission of renewal form with passing marksheets on NSP.

structured_rules.explanation: Student must have a certified benchmark disability of at least 40% verified via UDID or State Medical Board certificate.
Total annual family income from all sources must not exceed Rs. 8,00,000 during the current financial year.
Institution must be recognized and approved by AICTE.
Must be admitted to 1st year of Degree/Diploma or 2nd year via lateral entry.
Student must not be receiving any other government scholarship concurrently.

benefits.duration: Maximum 4 years for Degree (3 years for lateral entry); maximum 3 years for Diploma (2 years for lateral entry)
benefits.maximum_benefit: Rs. 50,000 per annum lump-sum covering tuition fees, purchase of computers/laptops, assistive devices, software, books, and stationery

required_documents.document_name: Unique Disability ID (UDID) Card / Disability Certificate (>= 40%)
required_documents.applicable_condition: Issued by Competent Medical Authority showing at least 40% benchmark disability
required_documents.issuing_authority: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities / Medical Board

required_documents.applicable_condition: All applicants (stating income <= Rs. 8 Lakh for current financial year)

required_documents.document_name: Bonafide Certificate from Head of Institution

application_steps: Step 1: Register on the National Scholarship Portal (NSP) with Aadhaar and obtain OTR credentials.
Step 2: Select AICTE Saksham Scholarship Scheme (Degree or Diploma).
Step 3: Fill personal details, enter UDID number, and provide electronic verification consent for Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities database cross-check.
Step 4: Upload valid disability certificate / UDID card, current financial year income certificate, bonafide certificate, and marksheet.
Step 5: Submit application for online institutional (Level 1) verification followed by AICTE nodal (Level 2) approval.
Step 6: Payment disbursed directly via DBT into student's Aadhaar-seeded bank account upon successful verification.
renewal_deadline: Concurrent with fresh application timelines on NSP (student submission open through 2026-11-30)
selection_process: Clause 3.0 provides that all eligible specially-abled students who meet admission, income, and disability criteria receive the scholarship upon successful verification (historical cap of 1,000 was removed in 2020 revision). However, eligibility does not equate to automatic payment without institutional and nodal validation on NSP.
application_tracking_information: Supported on NSP portal via OTR login

current_guideline_version.version_title: AICTE Swanath Scholarship Scheme Revised Guidelines
current_guideline_version.issuing_authority: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)

historical_guideline_info.key_differences: Covered only 3 categories: (1) Orphans, (2) COVID-19 deceased parents, and (3) Martyred armed forces wards; initially restricted to 1st year and lateral entry. The May 2025 revision expanded coverage to 4 categories (adding critical illness and severe accident disability > 80%) and opened eligibility to students enrolled in any study year (1st to 4th year Degree, 1st to 3rd year Diploma).

eligibility.income_definition: Total annual family income from all sources must not exceed Rs. 8 Lakh during the financial year of application
eligibility.education_requirement: Enrolled in regular-mode technical Degree (1st, 2nd, 3rd, or 4th year) or Diploma (1st, 2nd, or 3rd year) course in an AICTE-approved institution
eligibility.minimum_marks_requirement: Enrolled as a regular student in the approved program
eligibility.course_requirement: Technical Degree or Diploma program in AICTE-approved institution
eligibility.family_status_requirement: Must belong to ANY ONE of the following four alternative categories: (1) Orphan child, OR (2) Parent(s) died due to COVID-19, OR (3) Ward of Armed Forces / CPMF martyred in action, OR (4) Parent suffering from critical life-threatening disease OR died / became severely disabled (> 80%) in an accident (as per RPwD Act 2016)
other_eligibility_conditions: Must have an active individual savings bank account seeded with Aadhaar
Must not be recipient of any other Central or State Government scholarship
exclusions: Students enrolled in non-AICTE approved institutions
Family income exceeding Rs. 8 Lakh
Recipients of other concurrent scholarship or fee reimbursement schemes
eligibility.renewal_conditions: Passing examinations in previous academic year and continuing regular full-time study in the same program.

structured_rules.explanation: Must satisfy at least ONE of four categories: (1) Orphan, (2) COVID-19 deceased parent, (3) Martyred armed forces personnel ward, or (4) Parent suffering from critical life-threatening disease or died / severely disabled (> 80%) in accident.

Candidate must not receive any other government scholarship concurrently.

benefits.duration: Remaining duration of the course (up to 4 years for Degree, up to 3 years for Diploma)
benefits.maximum_benefit: Rs. 50,000 per annum lump-sum covering college tuition fees, books, computer, stationery, and software

required_documents.applicable_condition: All applicants (10th/12th or previous year marksheet for currently enrolled students)
All applicants (stating income <= Rs. 8 Lakh issued by competent State/UT authority)

historical_guideline_info.key_differences: Scaled fresh slots from 1,500 (2021-22) to 1,900 (2025-26), totaling 8,500 fresh slots in the 5-year block. Preserved tuition fee caps (Rs. 2.00 lakh for private, Rs. 3.72 lakh for private flying clubs) and academic allowances (Rs. 86,000 Year 1, Rs. 41,000 subsequent years) which are continued in the 2026-27 guidelines.
Academic support was itemized as Rs. 3,000/month living expenses + Rs. 5,000/year books + Rs. 45,000 one-time computer grant. Unified into annual Academic Allowance from 2021 onwards.

eligibility.gender_requirement: ALL (At least 30% slots reserved for SC girl students within each institution)
eligibility.income_definition: Total annual family income from all sources for the preceding financial year
eligibility.education_requirement: Completed Class 12 with a minimum of 60% marks and secured admission in a notified premier institution
eligibility.minimum_marks_requirement: Minimum 60% marks in Class 12 examination and qualifying entrance rank for admission into notified institution
eligibility.course_requirement: Full-time degree or post-graduate courses in notified premier institutions
eligibility.institution_requirement: Empanelled/notified premier institutions listed under 2026-27 scheme notification (over 260+ premier institutions including IITs, IIMs, NITs, AIIMS, NLUs, NIFTs, central universities)
eligibility.family_status_requirement: Limited to a maximum of two siblings from the same family
other_eligibility_conditions: Must belong to Scheduled Caste (SC) community
Must have secured admission through regular entrance test / counseling process into a notified institution
Must maintain an active bank account seeded with Aadhaar
exclusions: Non-SC students
Students scoring below 60% in Class 12
Students studying in institutions not empanelled under the 2026-27 notification
Annual family income exceeding Rs. 8 Lakh
More than two siblings from the same family
Students receiving other full government scholarships
eligibility.renewal_conditions: Continuation in subsequent years depends on satisfactory academic performance and passing promotional annual/semester examinations without backlogs.

application_steps: Step 1: Obtain admission to a notified premier institution and secure admission fee receipt / bonafide.
Step 2: Register on National Scholarship Portal (NSP) using Aadhaar OTR.
Step 3: Select Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment -> Top Class Education Scheme for SC Students.
Step 4: Upload SC caste certificate, family income certificate, admission proof, fee structure, Class 12 marksheet (>= 60%), and entrance rank proof.
Step 5: Submit application for Institute Nodal Officer (INO) verification.
Step 6: Approved by Ministry Project Monitoring Unit with DBT disbursement of maintenance and fee release.
renewal_deadline: Concurrent with fresh application timelines on NSP (student submission open through 2026-11-30)
selection_process: Merit within allotted institution slots (published under 2026-27 notification at socialjustice.gov.in/schemes/27) based on entrance exam ranks. 30% slots earmarked for SC female students.
grievance_contact: MSJE Scholarship Division: dbtcell-msje@nic.in / NSP Helpdesk
application_tracking_information: Supported on NSP portal via OTR login
